title: Coupon codes feature
prompt: Implement coupon support end to end. Add shop/coupons.py with class InvalidCoupon(ValueError) and redeem(code, amount) -> float. Codes are case-insensitive: SAVE10 takes 10 percent off, FLAT5 takes 5 off (never returning below 0). Any other code raises InvalidCoupon. Extend shop.orders.place_order with coupon=None. Order of operations: subtotal, then the percentage discount_percent, then the coupon, then tax. The returned dict must gain a 'net' key (amount after discount and coupon, before tax) and, when a coupon was used, a 'coupon' key with the code. Add tests in tests/ for the feature, document it in README.md, and run the test suite before finishing. Do not ask questions; make reasonable decisions.
